answer: Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. The pulse edge is recorded both ways, so a closed ring of 176 clones produces a signature the atlas analysis flags immediately. An farming party must thus build an open graph reaching real agents, and hence doing work rather than printing keys, and the gale settlement applies the void retroactively. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
